func.note: steps tuned at width 128 and reused (PREREG section 8)

A1.rule: S2-5 and S1: mean(B2 tuned) - mean(A tuned) >= -1.0 point (PASS = Phase 1's 'A beats replay' is not supported)

A2.rule: S2-5 and S1: mean(kNN-all) - mean(A tuned) >= +5.0 points

A3.rule: S2-5: unique(C) / unique(A) in [0.6, 1.2] and reported(C) > 2 x unique(C)

B1.rule: F-15 and F-30: mean paired A tuned - B2* >= +5.0 points and the 95% interval excludes 0

B2.rule: F-15 and F-30: A tuned - kNN-all >= +10.0 points

B3.rule: F-30: B4 - A >= +5.0 points (reported; no gate)

C1.rule: S2-30: predict multiply-adds(A) >= 0.5 x multiply-adds(kNN-all) (PASS = no compute saving; reported, no gate)

kill_rule: B1 FAIL: the dynamic pool is not shown to beat a dense network on streams that need computed answers; the MoE track stops claiming an accuracy advantage and re-scopes to a compute saver and abstention layer over an episodic memory.
